row:
My name is Minnie and I am a veterinarian from the UK!

I'm passionate about my profession and sharing it with the world! I will be making videos about all sorts of topics that will be accessible to everyone, whether you're a vet or not! 

I am also soon-to-be working with Sea Turtles in the Maldives and I'll be wanting to share everything I know and love about these incredible reptiles and I give you an idea of what it is like to live and work in a beautiful yet remote slice of paradise. 

I hope you enjoy and engage, and maybe even come away having learned a little something!

(p.s. I am also a massive dork so I can't promise 100% educational content all the time....)
